_about: Pages another lane owns while it rebuilds them. chrome.py, mesh.py and links.py neither rewrite nor check these pages while they are listed. WEB-FSC-6 owns this set. Whichever of WEB-FSC-4 and WEB-FSC-6 lands second empties the list, then runs chrome.py, mesh.py, links.py --relink and sitemap.py over the whole tree and reruns the gates.
